description: This file defines a class 'NegUnary' in the Twig templating engine, representing a unary negation operation within Twig's expression parsing system.

classes.name: NegUnary
classes.description: A class representing unary negation expression in Twig's abstract syntax tree, extending 'AbstractUnary' and implementing an 'operator' method to return the negation operator.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw '-' operator to be used in PHP code generation for negating an expression.
